programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: After witnessing agricultural practices in far-flung places like Bhutan and Okinawa, host Mike dives into the world of sustainable gardening right in his own backyard. With the guidance of a local soil scientist, we follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably. From planting the first seeds to navigating unexpected challenges, this episode offers a candid look at the highs and lows of gardening for sustainability. Beyond the physical labor and the harvest, we also explore the emotional and mental rewards of this earthy endeavor. Mike learns that the act of growing your own food is not just a means to an end—it's a therapeutic practice that nurtures the mind as well as the body. Tune in to see how the simple act of cultivating a garden can yield abundant lessons in sustainability, health, and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We embark on a unique journey around the world to film our series but behind the scenes explore the effects of stress on the human body. Equipped with cutting-edge Hexo Skin sensors and other wearable tech, we subject ourselves to adrenaline-pumping activities like skydiving and roller coaster rides, as well as draining experiences like red-eye flights. By monitoring real-time data, we gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses. From heart rate fluctuations to sleep monitoring this episode reveals how stress can be both an exhilarating and exhausting experience. As we push the limits of adventure—and our own comfort zones—we discover that creating a health series can be a surprisingly stressful endeavor in itself. Tune in to uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being and learn what we can do to manage it effectively.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programme.title: A Life Reset

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 1 introduces the practice of centering through the breath. When the mind drifts to regret or worry, we gently return—again and again. This meditation teaches concentration, presence, and compassion, reminding us that healing isn’t in never wandering, but in beginning again.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 2 invites us to examine the stories we tell about our worth, limits, and lives. By recognizing conditioned habits and outdated coping tools, we reconnect with our power of choice. This lesson reminds us that change is always possible—and that we can meet life with renewed care and curiosity.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

programme.title: Hope Is Here

Jill's fighting spirit and her desire to help find a cure and eradicate the stigma that only smokers contracted the disease would eventually define her legacy.

programme.title: Hope Is Here

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Solymar visita la agencia de publicidad al sentirse movida por la culpa de creerse traicionando a su amiga Yubiri al haber aceptado un noviazgo con Wilker | Yubiri sintiéndose sorprendida por la noticia interroga a Solymar al verse sumergida en la ignorancia en cuanto a los sentimientos de su mejor amiga por Wilker | Solymar deja en manos de Yubiri la decisión de su relación con Wilker al sentirse decidida a acatar el mandato de su amiga para llevar a cabo o no su noviazgo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Paco pide un préstamo monetario a Gonzálo. María Antonia se entera por la policía de que es la propietaria del terreno donde se está construyendo el centro comercial. Paco recibe una lección de humildad debido a un accidente.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Marcelo intenta salvar el matrimonio de Ricardo y Manuela, mientras Katiuska y Verónica planean separarlos tras la partida de Graciela. Ricardo casi mata a Celia por sus intrigas, pero regresa con Manuela para darle otra oportunidad. Elizabeth enferma y es llevada al médico por Ricardo. Margot confronta a Hortensia, y Misael recurre a Manuela para rescatar a su sobrino Gregory. Finalmente, el Padre Alejandro usa sus habilidades de karate para rescatar al niño de unos delincuentes.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo visita a Erasto y le reprocha haber ocultado la existencia de su hija con Consuelo; Erasto lo expulsa. José Luis informa a la residencia que Blanca fue envenenada y Carmen acusa a la "amiga rara". Consuelo echa a Isaías tras llevarlo Rosa ebrio. Amalia descubre que Alejandro pasó la noche con Rosalía. Natalia confiesa a Mildred las humillaciones que vivió con Erasto. Carmen va a casa de Arminda a gritarle en la cara que ella envenenó a Blanca, pero que sigue viva. Maricela teme que Adolfo quiera quitarle su empresa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leo descubre a Alejandra hablando mal de su familia y aunque ella admitió burlarse solo de Irene, él no confía para nada en la licenciada Altamirano. El médico dijo que Rebeca debía descansar y tratarse con un especialista, pero que estaba bien. Más calmado, Leonardo fue a buscar a Irene para darse cuenta de que ella se había ido. Irene fue a lo de Felipe en busca de consuelo y tranquilidad para pensar. Habló mucho con él y le dijo que le contaría a Leonardo sobre su hijo pero que no sabía si podría seguir con su matrimonio de esta manera. La casa de los Ferrándiz es un caos, todos están muy confundidos incluyendo a los niños y el personal. Keka extraña mucho a Irene, lo que irrita a Agustina.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol cita a Reina a la mansión Monserrat, donde se lleva la sorpresa de encontrarse con Alejandro, Alicia y su hija abandonada, Cristina. Reina no soporta el momento y decide salir a hablar con Alejandro, donde, llorando, le confiesa que es verdad que ella abandonó a su hija. Alicia niega todo y se va con Carlos.Aída se encuentra en un estado de borrachera crítico, y al no soportar la miseria que vive, toma un arma, decidida a suicidarse. Sol trata de contenerla y lograr que se calme.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca da una conferencia de prensa polémica donde afirma que desde su regreso está mejor que nunca con Leonardo y que planea volver a su familia y trabajo como la legítima señora Ferrándiz que nunca dejó de ser. Ante esto Irene decide definitivamente anular su matrimonio con Leonardo y no quiere decirle nada sobre su bebé. Leonardo entristecido por su crisis con Irene, enfurece con lo que hizo Rebeca. Por otro lado, Carlos Ernesto y Virginia descubren más cosas sospechosas sobre el regreso de Rebeca, y él cada vez confía menos en ella por lo que decide viajar hasta la isla donde estuvo Rebeca y buscar información. Agustina también sospecha que Rebeca está ocultando algo y que eso comenzó mucho antes del accidente.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol convence a Aida para que no se quite la vida y le quita el arma que tenía en su poder. Además le dice que quiere que ella se la institutriz de Esperancita. Maricielo confronta a Alicia y le dice que ya sabe que su esposo es Carlos. Alicia trata de justificarse pero Maricielo le dice que tiene en su poder una carta del padre Ramón que explica la jugada sucia que Alicia le estaba haciendo. Ricarda está preocupada por que se manche la reputación de su marido.

Jarol confesó ser el autor intelectual y fue condenado a 32 años de prisión. Rocío permanece prófuga, rehaciendo su vida en Argentina.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila and Max offend each other with irony and hurtful phrases. The four women involved in the betrayal meet again to ally themselves and annul Camila, but Mother Isabel prevails. Both Father Tiziano and Luciano warn about the danger of the marriage between Camila and Ezequiel.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: En Moscú ocurren asesinatos misteriosos. En cada asesinato se muere el criminal que cometió el crimen anterior... pero el departamento operativo de la policía no logra seguir el rastro del asesino. Además, el comandante altamente profesional Sergey Odintsov no puede trabajar después de haber sido gravemente herido, aunque está tratando de realizar su propia investigación. Los problemas familiares no le permiten concentrarse en el trabajo: su hija está gravemente enferma y se necesita el dinero para medicamentos costosos, su automóvil se daña y no tiene para repararlo... una solución llega inesperadamente como en forma de ganar la lotería, sobre lo cual Elena, la esposa de Sergey, es notificada por SMS. Aunque no todo es tan fácil, porque para obtener esta gran victoria se debe cumplir una condición: matar a una persona...

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: Es evidente que el titiritero conoce bien a los participantes de su cruel juego: por dinero, están dispuestos a todo. Solo una joven parece haber terminado en este grupo por pura coincidencia.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: La oferta impacta a la joven, quien decide contarle todo a su esposo, que es policía.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: Ahora deben encontrar al organizador antes de que ocurra otro asesinato. Para ello, necesitan descubrir qué relación tiene la protagonista con la persona que le han encargado matar. El problema es que ella no tiene la menor idea de quién es esa persona ni qué los une…
